name: Coupled Density and Velocity Estimation
definition: A strategy to solve the ill-posed tomography problem with few cameras by predicting the current density field based on previous time steps using physical priors (transport and incompressibility), enabling efficient interactive reconstruction.
summary: Coupled Density and Velocity Estimation is a physics-based strategy that reconstructs fluid flow fields from sparse video by coupling density and velocity estimation through physical priors for efficient interactive tomography.
